jobs.title: Customer  Success  Associate
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Toronto! As a Customer Success Associate you will be responsible for driving strategy for the Achievers recognition and engagement platform while continuously driving value for our customers. You will play a key role with our customers by promoting product adoption and expansion, highlighting best practices and implementing recognition strategies. If you are passionate about customer success, have a knack for sales and a flare for technology you’ll fit right in!

jobs.title: Customer Support Advisor
jobs.description_text: A Customer Support Advisor is a highly skilled, customer-focused professional responsible for delivering exceptional support to both program administrators (clients) and members. This role primarily supports program administrators (CSS function) while also contributing to Member Support to ensure seamless end-to-end service. In this role, you will own a diverse portfolio of support cases, including complex and escalated issues. You bring a strong understanding of the platform, apply advanced problem-solving skills, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive timely and effective resolutions. You are viewed as a trusted resource within the team and contribute to elevating overall support quality.

jobs.title: Customer Value & Growth Program Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. We are looking for someone who brings a commercial point of view, challenges the plans on the table, contributes to the thinking, and acts as a genuine partner to every function involved.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Intelligence
jobs.description_text: The Marketplace is the rewards shopping experience within the Achievers platform. Its performance is shaped by a connected set of drivers, including member access, traffic, utilization, conversion, redemption, catalogue relevance, vendor performance, fulfilment reliability and the economics of each transaction. As Manager, Marketplace Performance Intelligence, you will give Marketplace one clear view of performance and turn intelligence into coordinated action. You will lead Marketplace operational analytics and identify opportunities to improve performance and scalability, own the analytics roadmap and recurring performance routines, and shape executive narratives/decisions. You will work in close partnership with the Finance Manager, Marketplace through a formal dotted-line relationship, connecting FP&A’s official financial outlook and governance with deeper customer, member and operational evidence. This role is also expected to structure and execute complex analyses that are cross-functional, commercially material, ambiguous or executive-facing. Success requires strong analytical judgement, commercial curiosity and executive communication. You will work across Marketplace, FP&A, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Product Marketing, BI, Product Analytics, ProDev and Support to strengthen the analytical foundation, clarify ownership and translate findings into measurable action.

jobs.description_text: About Achievers Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter. Our commitment to you: At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights. The Opportunity: We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to join our growing sales team in Sydney! In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful impact by helping mid-sized businesses achieve their goals through our solutions. You’ll take ownership of identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and driving revenue growth within the mid-market segment.

jobs.description_text: Achievers is an employee recognition and engagement platform, and our mission is to Change the Way the World Works. We help companies celebrate great work, build stronger cultures, and make sure people feel valued. Every day, our platform powers millions of recognition moments for global, multi-generational workforces. As a Product Designer in our Member Experience domain, you will be the full-time designer for our Campaigns and Recognition teams, working alongside the Product Managers and engineers on each. You will design the experiences people use to recognize one another and the experiences our customers use to run campaigns, from the first question about the problem through to shipped work and what we learn from it. You will operate as both a player and a builder—owning deal desk ticket execution and complex deal support while driving process optimization, automation, and scalable improvements. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to structure high-quality deals across land, expand, and renewal motions, directly impacting ARR growth, deal velocity, and long-term customer value. You will enable efficient deal progression while also building the frameworks, guardrails, and processes that create consistency and scale. You will balance strong collaboration and commercial flexibility with clear standards and operational rigor, ensuring deals support both immediate revenue objectives and sustainable growth, while reducing friction in the deal process by improving upfront clarity and enabling stronger deal structuring at the source.
